SMITA PAWAR Senior Business Analyst | Certified Scrum Master

Pune, India | smita.chavan26@gmail.com | +91 7972616207 / 9975502095

SUMMARY

Business Analyst and Certified Scrum Master with 11+ years of experience in Healthcare IT and insurance. Experienced in working with US Healthcare payer and provider processes, requirements analysis, Agile delivery and healthcare application integrations. Strong in facilitating Scrum ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, stakeholder discussions, UAT and cross-functional delivery. Hands-on experience with EDI X12 834 and 835 transactions, HL7/FHIR integrations and HIPAA- compliant healthcare environments. Worked on Aetna, GE Healthcare and Baxter engagements.

SCRUM MASTER / AGILE

Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.

Coordinate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, development and QA teams to keep stories ready and delivery on track.

Track sprint progress, blockers, dependencies, risks and action items and follow up with the appropriate teams for closure.

Support backlog prioritization and refinement by converting business requirements into clear user stories and acceptance

criteria.

Work with stakeholders on release planning, requirement priorities, sprint goals and delivery expectations.

Facilitate discussions between business and technical teams and help resolve issues affecting sprint delivery.

Support continuous improvement through retrospectives, process standardization and better team documentation.

US HEALTHCARE / BUSINESS ANALYSIS

US Healthcare payer and provider experience covering insurance, benefits, enrollment, eligibility, claims, reimbursement

and healthcare application workflows.

Worked with EDI X12 834 and 835 transactions for healthcare enrollment and payment/remittance processes, including

analysis, mapping, validation, testing and issue resolution.

Hands-on HL7/FHIR integration experience, including data mapping, message validation and analysis of interface issues.

Worked with HL7 ADT, ORM and ORU message flows and interface engines including Cloverleaf, Rhapsody and ConnectR.

Strong Business Analysis experience across requirements gathering, gap analysis, BRD, FRD, SRS, user stories, acceptance

criteria, data mapping and UAT.

Experience working with HIPAA and healthcare data-governance requirements.

CORE SKILLS

Agile & Scrum: Scrum Master, Scrum Ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, Release Planning, Agile Delivery, Stakeholder Management Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering, Gap Analysis, BRD, FRD, SRS, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, UAT, Data Mapping, Process Analysis Healthcare: US Healthcare, Payer, Provider, Healthcare Insurance, Claims, Enrollment, Eligibility, Reimbursement, EDI X12 834/835, HL7, FHIR, HIPAA, EHR/EMR Tools: JIRA, Azure DevOps, Rally, Confluence, SQL, MS Excel, Visio, Draw.io, ServiceNow, Service Cloud

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Scrum Master (CSM)

PRINCE2 Agile Foundation and Practitioner – Agile Project Management

Business English Certificate – Cambridge (B1)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Tquanta Technologies – Contract (Cognizant), Pune | 01/2026 – 05/2026

Smita Pawar | Senior Business Analyst | Certified Scrum Master | US Healthcare

Senior Business Analyst/Scrum Master

Facilitated daily stand-ups, sprint planning and backlog grooming and worked with the team to keep sprint activities on

track.

Owned and prioritized product backlog items and created user stories with clear acceptance criteria for development

teams.

Worked closely with engineers, designers and Project Managers to clarify requirements and resolve delivery issues and

dependencies.

Supported product roadmap discussions and aligned business priorities with technical delivery plans.

Coordinated cross-functional discussions to improve backlog readiness and maintain delivery timelines.

Used AI-assisted tools such as Claude and Copilot for requirement analysis, backlog refinement and documentation.

Citius Tech Healthcare, Pune | 09/2022 – 06/2025

Senior Business Analyst – Projects: GE Healthcare, Baxter

Facilitated Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning and backlog grooming for healthcare product

delivery.

Worked with business stakeholders and delivery teams to refine requirements, prioritize work and prepare sprint-ready user

stories.

Prepared BRDs, FRDs and user stories and translated business requirements into functional requirements and acceptance

criteria.

Worked on payer and provider healthcare workflows and supported analysis of EDI X12 834 and 835 transactions for

enrollment and payment/remittance processes.

Led data mapping and documentation for HL7/FHIR interface development and coordinated resolution of integration issues.

Conducted client demos, requirement discussions and progress reviews with stakeholders and senior leadership.

Supported UAT, issue analysis and resolution across business, development and integration teams while ensuring HIPAA

and data-governance compliance.

Altera Digital Health (Team Lead), Pune | 07/2016 – 09/2022

MS Senior Systems Analyst / Team Lead

Managed a team of 15+ analysts supporting enterprise healthcare applications and coordinated day-to-day delivery

activities.

Worked across healthcare payer/provider application workflows and supported requirements, integration and production

activities.

Managed HL7 message routing including ADT, ORM, ORU and SI flows using Cloverleaf, Rhapsody and ConnectR interface

engines.

Coordinated with EHR vendors and development teams to resolve integration discrepancies and perform mapping

validation.

Supported go-live, incident response, system upgrades and production support activities for healthcare applications.

Tracked project and team performance using Azure DevOps and supported process improvement and change management

activities.

Infosys, Pune | 01/2014 – 07/2016

Senior Application Analyst – Project: Aetna Insurance

Worked on a US Healthcare Insurance project for Aetna, supporting policy, benefits and customer-facing healthcare

application processes.

Worked with healthcare insurance requirements and supported payer-side policy and benefit processes.

Performed requirements gathering and client communication to understand policy, benefits and application issues.

Analyzed healthcare data, reimbursement information, comparative rates and financial impact calculations.

Verified policy and benefit information across web-based and mainframe systems and coordinated issue resolution with

support teams.

Managed high-volume incidents and followed up with L2 teams to meet committed resolution timelines.

Smita Pawar | Senior Business Analyst | Certified Scrum Master | US Healthcare

EDUCATION

Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA) – Pune University | 2016

Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA) – Shivaji University | 2011

Smita Pawar | Senior Business Analyst | Certified Scrum Master | US Healthcare
